# R Script Following Steps from Vignett of the Coefficient of Variant calculations across kidney and heart tissue of humans and rats

## Installing Dependencies

__ !!! IMPORTANT NOTE !!! ___

__ Source the `functions/environment_setup.R` script in R environment to install `dplyr`, `BioConductor`, and `CoSIA` as packages.  Removed from the R Notebooks to reduce time and complexity of them.

```{r install-dependencies, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
beginning_time <- Sys.time()
library(dplyr)
library(CoSIA)
```

## Loading Monogenic Kidney Genes as sample genes to use

```{r loading-gene-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load("../inst/extdata/proccessed/monogenic_kidney_genes.rda")
set.seed(42)
monogenic_kid_sample <- dplyr::sample_n(monogenic_kidney_genes, 20)
monogenic_kid_sample
```

## Get Tissues For Species

> Quote from vignette: To compare across all shared tissues for your
> selected species, you can assign the `getTissues` output to an object
> as input for map_tissues when initializing a `CoSIAn` object.

notes: \
- “\_r_noregicus\_” in the vignette options in (#tab:Table1.) is
"\_r_norvegicus\_"\
- Saving the results of `CoSIA::getTissues` into a variable. However,
the walk through of the vignette is not using it.

```{r gathering-tissue-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
output_species <- c("h_sapiens", "r_norvegicus")
map_tissues <- CoSIA::getTissues(output_species)
```

## Configuring the base CoSIA package mostly similar in vignette 1.2.4

notes:\
- Not using all the tissues in this example, just
`` `adult mammalian kidney & heart` ``\
- Using mouse, rate, human as output species to generate matching gene
expression plot later in vignette walk through

todo: Read manual for the map_species parameter

```{r cosia-initialize}
CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_coefficient_variation_tissue = CoSIA::CoSIAn(
  gene_set = unique(monogenic_kid_sample$Gene),
  i_species = "h_sapiens",
  o_species = c(
    "h_sapiens",
    "r_norvegicus"
  ),
  input_id = "Symbol",
  output_ids = "Ensembl_id",
  map_species = c(
    "h_sapiens",
    "r_norvegicus"
  ),
  map_tissues = c(
    "adult mammalian kidney",
    "heart"
  ),
  mapping_tool = "annotationDBI",
  ortholog_database = "HomoloGene",
  metric_type = "CV_Tissue" # Calculating it across tissue
)
```

## Calculating species unique identifier mappings based on input gene symbol

```{r cosia-id-mapping}
CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_coefficient_variation_tissue_convert <- CoSIA::getConversion(CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_coefficient_variation_tissue)
head(CoSIA::viewCoSIAn(CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_coefficient_variation_tissue_convert, "converted_id"))
```

## Coefficient of Variation for Human and Rat Tissue

note: \# metric_type = "CV_Tissue"

Below is a reference example image of the expected plot from the vignette
<img src="../inst/images/CoSIA_CV_example.png" alt="Figure: Gene Expression Variability Across Species in Kidney Tissue" width="703"/>


```{r coefficient-of-variation-human-rat-tissue,  dpi=200, fig.height=13, fig.width=6 }
CoSIA_Vignette_expression_human_rat_tissue <- CoSIA::getGExMetrics(CoSIAn_Obj_Vignette_coefficient_variation_tissue_convert)
CoSIA_Vignette_coefficient_variation_plot_tissue <- CoSIA::plotCVGEx(CoSIA_Vignette_expression_human_rat_tissue)
CoSIA_Vignette_coefficient_variation_plot_tissue

end_time <- Sys.time()

time.loop <- end_time - beginning_time
cat("Time elapsed: ", round((time.loop),3), " minutes")
```
